title: Error budget arithmetic
instructions:
## How much can we break?

An SLO of 99.9% availability over a 30-day month allows 0.1% of the month to fail: that is the **error budget**. Work the numbers for the mobile money transfer service.

| Fact | Value |
|---|---|
| Month | 30 days = 43,200 minutes |
| Transfer SLO | 99.9% of requests succeed |
| Last month | 12,000,000 requests, 9,600 failed |
| This month so far | one 25-minute full outage |

Answer on the right; give minutes to one decimal place where needed.
hints: Budget in minutes = (1 − SLO) × minutes in the month: 0.001 × 43,200.
Budget remaining = budget − outage. If it is negative, feature releases pause until the budget recovers.

realityNote: Real SLOs are measured on rolling windows and with burn-rate alerts: a 2% budget burn in one hour pages someone, a slow burn over days opens a ticket. The number of nines is a business decision about cost, not an engineering target.
